findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done.
Case: normal use - viewing a published part with an old size stop and no local branch or checkout.
The filtering here is undone by `at_ref`: `src/forge/nextstep.py:938-939` rereads the published state without `without_size_stop` and replaces the filtered state. With no local branch, its early return at line 936 does not apply. Consequently, `_item` displays the old question and `forge close ... --resolve` instruction again. The board also calls `at_ref` (`src/forge/board.py:397`), restoring the same obsolete owner question. Apply the normalization to this final state read too. This leaves Done-when 3 unmet for the published-state scenario already covered by `test_5_a_saved_size_stop_shows_no_question_from_published_state`.
